name: impl-dependents-only-nested
description: CheckBeforeClean looks at dependents only below the top level

name: impl-no-global-scope-skip
description: CheckBeforeClean ignores global scope

name: impl-top-record-kept
description: the top-level %Clean never deletes the module record

name: impl-filecopy-deletes-all-copies
description: a file copy deletes every copied file, whatever its folder
old: Acc { w: W { present: a.w.present.difference(folder_set(a.w, folder)), ..a.w }, ..a }
new: Acc { w: W { present: a.w.present.difference(a.w.res.dom().filter(|x: nat| a.w.res[x].kind is Files)), ..a.w }, ..a }

name: impl-ignore-keep-flag
description: FileCopy ignores KeepOnUninstall
old:
if keep { a }
                else if file
new:
if false { a }
                else if file

name: impl-code-not-collected
description: %Clean does not collect code items for deletion

name: impl-no-exit-flag
description: uninstall zpm does not set the shell-exit flag

name: impl-record-delete-wrong-module
description: the record delete removes IPM's record instead of the target's

name: impl-clean-deletes-code
description: Clean at level 0 deletes the module's own code
old: pub open spec fn after_code(w2: W, m: Module, p: P) -> W { if p.level > 0 {
new: pub open spec fn after_code(w2: W, m: Module, p: P) -> W { if p.level >= 0 {

name: impl-not-found-ok
description: uninstall of an unknown name reports success
old: None => Out { w: W { hist: w.hist.push(HRow { m: None, ok: false }), ..w }, ok: false, skip: false },
new: None => Out { w: W { hist: w.hist.push(HRow { m: None, ok: false }), ..w }, ok: true, skip: false },

name: impl-clean-not-found-ok
description: clean of an unknown name reports success
old:
None => Out { w: w, ok: false, skip: false },
        Some(t) => exec_clean(w, t, P { level: 0,
new:
None => Out { w: w, ok: true, skip: false },
        Some(t) => exec_clean(w, t, P { level: 0,

name: impl-row-always-success
description: the uninstall log is always finalized as a success
old: Out { w: W { hist: o.w.hist.push(HRow { m: Some(t), ok: o.ok }), ..o.w }, ..o }
new: Out { w: W { hist: o.w.hist.push(HRow { m: Some(t), ok: true }), ..o.w }, ..o }

name: impl-record-delete-keeps-manifest
description: StudioDocument.Module:Delete keeps the stored manifest
old: Out { w: W { mods: o.w.mods.remove(t), streams: o.w.streams.remove(t), ..o.w }, ..o }
new: Out { w: W { mods: o.w.mods.remove(t), streams: o.w.streams, ..o.w }, ..o }

name: impl-success-reported-failed
description: worked => success: an uninstall that removed the module reports failure

name: impl-row-always-failure
description: worked => success row: the uninstall log is always finalized as a failure
old: Out { w: W { hist: o.w.hist.push(HRow { m: Some(t), ok: o.ok }), ..o.w }, ..o }
new: Out { w: W { hist: o.w.hist.push(HRow { m: Some(t), ok: false }), ..o.w }, ..o }

name: impl-hook-failure-ok
description: failed => no success: a failing Unconfigure hook is reported as success
old: if m.installer && !m.hook_ok { Out { w: w2, ok: false, skip: false } }
new: if m.installer && !m.hook_ok { Out { w: w2, ok: true, skip: false } }

name: premise-drop-pw
description: drop PW from the blocked-unchanged lemma

name: premise-drop-pb
description: drop PB from the honest lemma
old:
premise_pb(w, lookup(w, n.key)->0, force, global),
        premise_pg(w), premise_pi

name: premise-drop-pg
description: drop PG from the dependents lemma
old:
requires wf_cmd(w, n), lookup(w, n.key) is Some, premise_pg(w),
    ensures l1_dependents_protect
new:
requires wf_cmd(w, n), lookup(w, n.key) is Some,
    ensures l1_dependents_protect

name: premise-drop-pga
description: drop PGA from the completeness lemma
old: premise_pga(w, lookup(w, n.key)->0), premise_pnf(n, force, answer),

name: premise-drop-pf
description: drop PF from the only-own lemma
old:
premise_pf(w), premise_pnf(n, force, answer),
    ensures l1_only_own

name: premise-drop-pn
description: drop PN from the self-guard lemma

name: premise-drop-pi
description: drop PI from the IPM-kept lemma
old:
premise_pi(w, lookup(w, n.key)->0, recurse),
    ensures l1_ipm_kept

name: premise-drop-pcw
description: drop PCW from the clean lemma

name: premise-drop-pnf
description: drop PNF from the kept-files lemma
old:
premise_pf(w), premise_pnf(n, force, answer),
    ensures l1_kept_files

name: premise-drop-pr
description: drop PR from the manifest lemma
old:
lookup(w, n.key) is Some, premise_pr(recurse), premise_pnf(n, force, answer),
    ensures l1_manifest_with_record
new:
lookup(w, n.key) is Some, premise_pnf(n, force, answer),
    ensures l1_manifest_with_record

name: wf-drop-ipm-no-deps
description: drop the manifest fact that IPM declares no dependencies (needed for worked => success of uninstall zpm -r)

name: bound-drop-fuel
description: drop the fuel bound from the honest lemma (fuel spent at the top makes uninstall zpm -r fail after removing IPM)

name: l1-same-ns-ignores-present
description: vacuity: L1 'unchanged' that ignores deleted artifacts loses the blocked-uninstall witness

name: l1-self-guard-trivial
description: vacuity: L1 without the self-uninstall guard loses the external-name witness

name: l1-no-dependents-rule
description: vacuity: L1 without 'dependents protect' loses the unresolvable-dependent witness

name: l1-globals-exempt
description: vacuity: L1 that lets every global stay loses the global witness

name: l1-no-kept-files
description: vacuity: L1 without the keep flag rule loses the shared-folder witness
old: w.present.contains(r) && w.res.contains_key(r) && (w.res[r].kind matches RKind::Files { keep: true, .. }) ==> o.w.present.contains(r)

name: l1-clean-record-only
description: vacuity: L1 for clean that checks only the record loses the clean witness
old:
&&& forall|r: nat| #![trigger o.w.present.contains(r)] owns(w, t, r) && w.present.contains(r) ==> o.w.present.contains(r)
    &&& forall|i: int| w.hooks.len() <= i < o.w.hooks.len() ==> o.w.hooks[i] != t

name: l1-ipm-record-only
description: vacuity: L1 that checks only IPM's record loses the -r-removes-IPM witness

name: l1-rows-unchecked
description: vacuity: L1 that does not check success rows loses the skipped-dependency witness

name: l1-manifest-unchecked
description: vacuity: L1 that does not check stored manifests loses the leftover-manifest witness
